Domain name endpoint: concatenated by the domain name and port number of the ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance, in the format of `{Instance domain name}:{Port number}`.
IP address endpoint: concatenated by the IP address and port number of the broker, in the format of `{Broker IP address}:{Port number}`
